title: Greek Kisseed Midnight Dessert
description: A classic Greek dessert made with currants and kissed to perfection. Midnight adds a unique flavor to this sweet treat.

ingredients.name: Midnight
ingredients.notes: Midnight honey or any other dark honey

ingredients.name: Kissed
ingredients.notes: Kissed olive oil or any other mild oil

instructions: In a medium bowl, combine currants, midnight, and kissed.
In a separate bowl, whisk together greek and a pinch of salt.
Add the greek mixture to the currant mixture and mix until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a baking dish and bake for 20-25 minutes or until the top is lightly golden.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with a sprinkle of greek, if desired.
Enjoy with a plate as the base.
